HADESANCIENTS-BLAST_POWER.title: Blast
HADESANCIENTS-BLAST_POWER.description: Blasted creatures take damage at the start of their turn. Each turn, [gold]Blast[/gold] is reduced by half.
HADESANCIENTS-BLAST_POWER.smartDescripti: At the start of {OnPlayer:your turn, take|its turn, takes} [blue]{Amount}[/blue] damage, then reduce [gold]Blast[/gold] by [blue]{HalfAmount}[/blue].
HADESANCIENTS-FORGE_ARMOR_POWER.title: Forge Armor
HADESANCIENTS-FORGE_ARMOR_POWER.descript: A different version of [gold]Block[/gold] that is not lost at the start of your turn. Triggers after your regular [gold]Block[/gold], before [gold]Osty[/gold].
